newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Mobutu did nothing but loot Zaire-Zimbabwe's Mugabe.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu did nothing but loot Zaire-Zimbabwe's Mugabe.

text.p: Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe accused deposed Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko of looting his country and doing "absolutely nothing" to develop it.
Mugabe was quoted by Zimbabwe's state news agency ZIANA making the comment during a meeting with visiting former Australian Prime Minister Bob Hawke.
"Really I think it's for the better for Mobutu. For over three decades he has done absolutely nothing to develop that country other than amass wealth for himself," Mugabe said.
Mobutu is believed to be one of the wealthiest people in the world.
Mugabe said he hoped southern Africa could use its influence on Zaire's new leader Laurent Kabila to ensure the country enjoys peace and economic development.
